work_packages.title: Candidate discovery and source screen
work_packages.objective: Identify real transportation policy instruments and reject candidates without official legislative, administrative, and scoring source paths.

work_packages.title: Federal effect and transition-cost score
work_packages.objective: Admit source-custodied annual federal effects and transition costs without interpolation.

work_packages.title: Behavior phase-in and stress model
work_packages.objective: Document behavioral response, implementation timing, adverse realization, and fallback costs.

work_packages.title: Complete applicable transportation floors
work_packages.objective: Populate policy and stress values for every applicable service floor and issue pass/fail evidence.

work_packages.title: Reform admission and role review
work_packages.objective: Admit at most one defensible reform scenario after reconciliation, source audit, and eight-role review.

admission_rules: A named real policy instrument is required.
Official legislative or administrative source custody is required.
Annual federal effects and transition costs remain null until scored evidence is admitted.
Complete applicable floors must pass under policy and stress paths.
No lower-cost or savings result is recognized from reference calibration alone.
TRN-D remains blocked until TRN-C closes.
public_warning: TRN-C completed with a conditional cost-only H.R. 2247 scenario and permits TRN-D to start. The bill is not enacted. No financing source, lower target cost, productivity savings, rate, or public card is admitted.
